import pyautogui; pyautogui.click(900, 300); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl','a'); pyautogui.press('delete'); pyautogui.write('Sub FixNum
Dim oDoc
oDoc = ThisComponent
Call SetRed(oDoc.getDrawPages())
Call SetRed(oDoc.getMasterPages())
oDoc.store()
MsgBox "OK"
End Sub

Sub SetRed(oPages)
Dim i, j, oPage, oShape
For i = 0 To oPages.getCount()-1
oPage = oPages.getByIndex(i)
For j = 0 To oPage.getCount()-1
oShape = oPage.getByIndex(j)
If oShape.supportsService("com.sun.star.presentation.SlideNumberShape") Then
oShape.CharColor = RGB(255,0,0)
End If
Next j
Next i
End Sub
', interval=0.01); pyautogui.press('f5')
memo: Typed macro FixNum+SetRed in Basic IDE (doc=saa-format-guide.pptx) and pressed F5. Expect MsgBox 'OK' -> click OK/press enter. If a Basic error dialog appears instead, read message and fix code. After OK, switch to Impress window to verify slide number is red; file already saved via oDoc.store().
